name: Global Transport Formulation
definition: A reconstruction approach that optimizes for a single initial density state $\rho_0$ and a velocity sequence $\{u_0, \dots, u_{F-1}\}$, rather than optimizing density $\rho_t$ at every time step individually. This enforces correct transport over the entire fluid flow trajectory.
summary: Global Transport Formulation is a tomographic reconstruction method that optimizes a single initial density state and velocity sequence, ensuring global consistency by propagating gradients through the full advection chain rather than treating density frames independently.
